cases.name: Futurist Spellthief
cases.text: When this creature enters, conjure a duplicate of target spell into your hand. That card perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."

cases.name: Lurking Spinecrawler
cases.text: When this creature enters, you may choose a nonland card in your hand. If you do, that card perpetually incorporates {1}{B} and gains "When you cast this spell, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice. Each opponent who can't discards a card."

cases.name: Racketeer Boss
